1.title: 概覽
content: 總是想找樂子並製造混亂的 ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加（Mauga）是一座會走路的砲塔，他能衝撞敵人並用雙機槍將其掃射殆盡。如果你想在面對危險時放聲大笑，同時正面扛下所有敵人的攻擊，那麼 ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加（Mauga）就是最適合你的坦克。透過他的被動技能 ![](/data/assets/guide/b0fa6db11f7513d7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fberserker.png)狂戰士（Berserker）以及 ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)心臟過載（Cardiac Overdrive）所產生的額外生命值，![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加（Mauga）輸出的傷害遠超敵人所能承受的範圍，同時他的治療速度也快到讓敵人無法將他擊殺。

他是終極的坦克決鬥者，在 1 對 1 的情況下能戰勝其他所有坦克。如果對方的坦克玩家不懂得如何反制他，那麼進行一場 ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加（Mauga）內戰將是他們唯一的生存希望。即使面對體型嬌小且機動性高的目標，槍法精準的玩家也能充分利用切換「槍尼（Gunny）」與「恰恰（Cha-cha）」的時機。![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加（Mauga）傾向於緊貼敵方坦克，在那裡他可以站穩腳步並同時扣下兩把槍的扳機。雖然他無法追擊高處的敵人，但 ![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)衝鋒（Overrun）讓他能在平坦的地形中稱霸全場。

1.1.1.title: 遊玩方式
content: * 集中火力攻擊敵方戰士（Tank）。雙管機槍是擊潰戰士的完美武器。試著讓敵方戰士保持在近距離，若他們試圖逃跑，就追擊他們。

* 不要總是使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)橫衝直撞（Overrun）來進行強勢開戰；試著以擊倒對手為目標。透過在奔跑途中取消技能來靈活應對，以便留在隊伍身邊並誘騙敵方交出冷卻技能。

* ![](/data/assets/guide/9b7ffe70b1afed44.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcage-fight.png)困獸鬥（Cage Fight）會封鎖所有位移技能，因此請專注於困住高機動性的英雄。

1.1.2.title: 對戰策略
content: * 保留你的傷害減免或機動性技能，以防止他在 ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)心臟過載（Cardiac Overdrive）期間對你造成傷害。

* ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加在施展 ![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)衝鋒（Overrun）時無法被阻擋。請站在他的衝鋒範圍之外，或準備好閃避他。

* 當他準備好施展 ![](/data/assets/guide/9b7ffe70b1afed44.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcage-fight.png)籠鬥（Cage Fight）時，要麼分散站位以免被困住，要麼讓所有人進入範圍內，這樣你和你的隊伍才能互相支援以在絕招中存活下來。

2.title: 優缺點總結
content: * 對抗坦克表現優異
* 具備自我維持（self sustain）能力
* 對控場（CC）免疫
* 需要造成傷害
* 缺乏垂直機動性
* 容易被忽略

3.1.1.title: 坦克剋星
content: 沒有坦克會想與 ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加單挑。對付 ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加的最佳坦克人選，是那些能夠在他施展 ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)心臟過載（Cardiac Overdrive）期間減免傷害的英雄。沒有任何坦克能單憑一己之力在傷害輸出或續戰力上勝過他。當敵方坦克表現強勢時，![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加能徹底壓制他們。

3.1.2.title: 自我維持
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/b0fa6db11f7513d7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fberserker.png)Berserker passive constantly grants overhealth from critical hits and burning targets. ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)Cardiac Overdrive’s life steal and damage reduction make you nearly unkillable for 3 seconds. Although he takes a lot of damage, ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga has strong self-agency in managing his health pool.

3.1.3.title: 控場免疫（CC immunity）
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png) 橫衝直撞（Overrun）是唯一能讓坦克完全無法被阻擋，甚至無法被駭入（Hacked）的技能。你可以抓準時機使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png) 橫衝直撞（Overrun）來反制敵方的暈眩效果，並中斷部分位移技能。

3.2.1.title: 依賴造成傷害來生存
content: 由於 ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加的治療效果取決於所造成的傷害以及能否點燃敵人，因此能夠減免傷害或賦予無敵狀態的技能會對他造成反制。面對擁有護盾或移動速度快且體型嬌小的英雄隊伍時，![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加整體的傷害輸出會降低，這也意味著他的生存能力會隨之下降。

3.2.2.title: 缺乏垂直機動性
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png) 橫衝直撞（Overrun）可以用來進行不錯的水平位移，但 ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png) 莫加（Mauga）無法處理位於高處的敵人。他雖然可以射擊這些敵人，但由於同時使用雙機槍時子彈擴散範圍過大，他被迫只能使用單機槍進行射擊。

3.2.3.title: 容易閃避
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加（Mauga）的移動方式非常線性。![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)衝鋒（Overrun）的路徑只能進行小幅度的調整，而且當他同時發射兩把機關槍時，移動速度會變得極慢。這些特性使他很容易被閃避，考慮到他最強的能力持續時間僅有短短的 3 秒，這點顯得尤為致命。

4.1.title: 主要攻擊：燃燒機關槍（Incendiary Chaingun）
content: **燃燒機關槍（Incendiary Chaingun）的使用技巧**
* 消耗戰（Poke）
* * 每當目標距離你超過 10 公尺，或是目標體型非常小時，你應該先使用「Gunny」進行射擊，直到將其點燃為止。
* 對抗飛行單位（Anti-flier）
* * 儘管當飛行單位距離較遠時，傷害衰減會變得相當嚴重，但你極高的射速與精準度使你非常擅長應對飛行單位。
* 一旦你點燃了目標，他們就必須撤退至掩體後方，因為死亡的威脅會變得過高。

4.2.title: 次要攻擊：揮發鏈砲（Volatile Chaingun）
content: **揮發鏈砲（Volatile Chaingun）的使用技巧**
* 自動暴擊
* 使用「恰恰（Cha-cha）」射擊的重點在於對燃燒中的敵人觸發自動暴擊。這能免費獲得雙倍傷害與治療量。
* 當燃燒效果結束後，請切換回「古尼（Gunny）」。
* 隊伍燃燒效果

* 揮發鏈砲（Volatile Chaingun）可以與隊友的燃燒效果搭配使用，例如 ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西（Ashe）的 ![](/data/assets/guide/17c0defbc2244ec8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdynamite.png)炸藥（Dynamite）或 ![](/data/assets/guide/954ef74e420324bc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Ftorbjorn.png)托比昂（Torbjörn）的 ![](/data/assets/guide/6db02d49ff2c55df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fmolten-core.png)熔火核心（Molten Core）。

4.3.title: 槍火與恰恰（同時射擊）
content: **槍火與恰恰的使用技巧**
* 僅適用於近距離
* 同時發射兩把機關槍會大幅增加子彈散佈。因此，請僅在目標非常靠近時才同時使用兩把槍。
* 傷害會加倍，若目標無法使用護盾或淨化（Cleanse），你將能使其持續處於燃燒狀態。
* 坦克剋星

* 槍火與恰恰讓 ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加成為名副其實的坦克剋星。坦克巨大的體型與高生命值使其成為完美的目標。如果敵方坦克讓你保持近距離並持續射擊，這就是你獲勝所需的全部條件。
* 移動速度

* ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加在同時發射兩把機關槍時，移動速度會變得極慢。敵人可以透過護盾、走位或繞過掩體來避開你。每當這種情況發生時，你需要切換單槍與雙槍射擊模式，以保持在攻擊範圍內。

4.4.title: [SHIFT]：狂奔（Overrun）
content: **![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)狂奔（Overrun）的使用技巧**
* 擊倒

* * 造成擊倒效果是使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)狂奔（Overrun）的最佳時機，因為擊倒造成的傷害與控制時間通常能轉化為一次快速的擊殺。
* 無法阻擋

* * 由於 ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加（Mauga）在 ![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)狂奔（Overrun）期間不會受到控場效果（CC）或駭入（Hack）影響，你可以刻意利用此技能來反制敵方的控場技能。
* 他在技能啟動的短暫動畫期間仍可能被暈眩，因此在某些情況下，你需要預判敵方技能的使用時機。
* 取消與繞圈跑法

* * 你不需要每次使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)狂奔（Overrun）都執著於撞擊敵人。那樣只會變成送頭並讓隊友感到挫折。

* 相反地，利用 ![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)狂奔（Overrun）帶來的威脅與壓力來爭奪空間，而不一定要完成撞擊。
* 你可以選擇取消衝刺，或是持續奔跑並繞回己方隊伍身邊。
* 誘騙敵方冷卻時間

* * ![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)狂奔（Overrun）的冷卻時間非常短，僅有 5 秒。幾乎所有其他技能的冷卻時間都比它長，因此如果敵人為了反制而對 ![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)狂奔（Overrun）交出技能，你就能利用下一次的 ![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)狂奔（Overrun）來懲罰他們。

4.5.title: [E]：心臟過載（Cardiac Overdrive）
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)心臟過載（Cardiac Overdrive）使用技巧
* 管理護甲

* * 理想情況下，你應該在還有護甲值時使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)心臟過載（Cardiac Overdrive），以最大化傷害減免效果。

* 此外，當 ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)心臟過載（Cardiac Overdrive）結束時，如果你已經沒有護甲，就需要撤退並尋求治療。
* 等待坦克傷害減免技能結束

* * 僅 3 秒的短暫持續時間與 12 秒的長冷卻時間，讓 ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)心臟過載（Cardiac Overdrive）很容易被浪費掉。

* 追蹤敵方坦克是否還有傷害減免技能可用，例如滿血的 ![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)萊因哈特（Reinhardt）護盾，或是 ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va 的 ![](/data/assets/guide/bd20cd06dd7b0779.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdefense-matrix.png)防禦矩陣（Defense Matrix）。他們可以輕易吸收你在心臟過載期間輸出的所有傷害，進而讓你無法獲得任何生命竊取效果。
* 隊友治療

* * 雖然 ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)心臟過載（Cardiac Overdrive）不再賦予隊友傷害減免，但它仍然能為他們提供生命竊取效果。

* 當附近的隊友生命值偏低且正在與敵人交戰時，你通常可以透過 ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)心臟過載（Cardiac Overdrive）來拯救他們。

4.6.title: （被動技能）：狂戰士（Berserker）
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/b0fa6db11f7513d7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fberserker.png)狂戰士（Berserker）的提示
* 保持火力全開

* ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加（Mauga）對燃燒中的敵人能造成更多傷害並更快地治療自己，因此在使用次要開火模式前，應始終先用主要開火模式點燃敵人。
* 在近距離時，同時使用兩把槍開火永遠是最佳選擇。

* 燃燒機關槍（Incendiary Chaingun）可以自然地對敵人造成爆頭傷害。你其實不需要等到目標著火才能獲得![](/data/assets/guide/b0fa6db11f7513d7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fberserker.png)狂戰士（Berserker）的增益。

4.7.title: 絕招：牢籠之戰（Cage Fight）
content: **![](/data/assets/guide/9b7ffe70b1afed44.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcage-fight.png)牢籠之戰（Cage Fight）使用技巧**
* 隔離敵人

* * ![](/data/assets/guide/9b7ffe70b1afed44.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcage-fight.png)牢籠之戰（Cage Fight）的最佳用法是將一到兩名敵人困在你的巨大屏障內。他們將與隊友隔絕，而你的隊伍其餘成員可以安全地集中火力消滅被困住的敵人。
* 困住高機動性敵人

* * 將那些總是跑得比你快的討厭英雄鎖在籠子裡來對付他們。像 ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王（Doomfist）這樣的敵人，在 ![](/data/assets/guide/9b7ffe70b1afed44.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcage-fight.png)牢籠之戰（Cage Fight）期間甚至無法使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/07a6c392a4903511.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-punch.png)火箭拳（Rocket Punch）或 ![](/data/assets/guide/177c26faed388178.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fseismic-slam.png)裂地重拳（Seismic Slam）。
* 牢籠之戰（Cage Fight）的反制手段

* * 隨時留意哪些敵方英雄擁有反制技能，例如 ![](/data/assets/guide/41367de8021167d5.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Flifeweaver.png)織命（Lifeweaver）的 ![](/data/assets/guide/70bdaf439d6cdcdd.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Flife-grip.png)生命之握（Life Grip）。在發動絕招前，請先確認這些技能近期已被使用過。

* 當敵人使用像是 ![](/data/assets/guide/feb976c891fbe2ae.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ftranscendence.png)聖（Transcendence）之類的絕招來反制 ![](/data/assets/guide/9b7ffe70b1afed44.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcage-fight.png)牢籠之戰（Cage Fight）時，最好取消該技能並使用「橫衝直撞（Overrun）」撤離。
* 人數優勢

* * 即使在使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/9b7ffe70b1afed44.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcage-fight.png)牢籠之戰（Cage Fight）時，你仍應確保隊伍擁有數量優勢。如果戰場上只剩下你自己和另一名隊友，那麼困住敵方全隊 5 人反而會適得其反。

5.1.1.title: 動能彈帶（Kinetic Bandolier）
5.1.1.description: 衝鋒（Overrun）在蓄力期間的第一秒內最多可裝填 150 發彈藥。
content: * 利基用途

* 在大多數彈藥耗盡的情況下，你通常也已經使用了 ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)心臟過載（Cardiac Overdrive），因此沒有足夠的生命值能直接衝向敵方陣線繼續進攻。
* 此外，在這些情況下，你通常也不會跑完完整的距離，因此無法獲得最多 150 發的彈藥補充。
* 減少空窗期

* ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加（Mauga）的裝填動畫比大多數英雄長得多，因此縮短裝填時間非常有益。
* 在面對消耗型（poke）與機動型（dive）陣容時很有用，因為你需要花更多時間進行消耗，然後突然需要衝入敵陣。

5.1.2.title: 縱火狂（Pyromaniac）
5.1.2.description: 使用燃燒機關槍（Incendiary Chaingun）點燃敵人可獲得 50 點超量生命值。
content: * 每當你點燃一名敵人時，會額外獲得一小段瞬間的超量生命值。這對於提升生存能力很有幫助，尤其是在必須採取較為被動的打法時效果最佳。

5.2.1.title: 火行者（Firewalker）
5.2.1.description: 衝鋒（Overrun）會點燃被擊中的敵人。
content: * 最佳主要特殊能力（major perks）

* 被點燃的敵人每秒會受到 15 點傷害，且能立即被恰恰（Cha-Cha）觸發自動暴擊。由於 ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加（Mauga）在衝鋒（Overrun）期間無法被阻擋，他可以輕鬆地在每次使用時點燃多名敵人。
* 爆發傷害
* 猛擊敵人，他們會立即被點燃。如果你以猛擊命中敵人的頭部中心，甚至還能從猛擊的暴擊中獲得治療。此外，你的傷害輸出會更快，因為你不必在觸發自動暴擊前，花時間用主要攻擊來點燃他們。

5.2.2.title: 戰鬥燃料（Combat Fuel）
5.2.2.description: 爆擊會使莫加（Mauga）在下次使用「心臟過載（Cardiac Overdrive）」時獲得 3 點額外暫時生命值，最多可累積至 150 點暫時生命值。
content: * 不需要額外的暫時生命值

* ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加（Mauga）在「心臟過載（Cardiac Overdrive）」期間的自我治療與傷害減免效果極強，你甚至不會感覺到那 100 點額外的暫時生命值有什麼差別。
* 再者，你需要在每次使用技能之間命中 50 次爆擊？實際上，你每次使用「心臟過載（Cardiac Overdrive）」時，平均大概只會獲得 50-60 點暫時生命值。
* 對抗治療無效與傷害減免的軟制衡

* ![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)戰鬥燃料（Combat Fuel）在面對擁有治療無效手段的英雄（例如安娜（Ana）的生化手榴彈），或是能抵銷你整個「心臟過載（Cardiac Overdrive）」持續時間的坦克時，或許能派上用場。理論上，額外的暫時生命值能讓你保住性命。
* 依然建議優先選擇「火行者（Firewalker）」。

6.title: 地圖
content: The best maps for ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga have small but open objective areas. The maps ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga struggles most on are those with lots of high ground, where dive comps are dominant. He has no vertical mobility, so ![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)Overrun gets little to no value against enemies who can run away to high ground he can’t reach. 7.1.title: 與其他英雄的個人配合
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西

* 雖然 ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加沒有護盾能讓 ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西躲在後面，但他的存在會吸引敵方隊伍的全神貫注，這為 ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西創造了進行狙擊與投擲 ![](/data/assets/guide/17c0defbc2244ec8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdynamite.png)炸藥（Dynamite）的空檔。![](/data/assets/guide/17c0defbc2244ec8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdynamite.png)炸藥（Dynamite）造成的燃燒效果也會觸發機關槍（Volatile Chaingun）的自動暴擊。這個組合對付脆皮英雄特別有效，因為 ![](/data/assets/guide/17c0defbc2244ec8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdynamite.png)炸藥（Dynamite）的巨額爆發傷害，結合 ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加的暴擊，讓敵人極難存活。用 ![](/data/assets/guide/17c0defbc2244ec8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdynamite.png)炸藥（Dynamite）命中敵方輔助英雄會迫使他們交出治療冷卻技能，並削弱他們坦克英雄的續航能力。
![](/data/assets/guide/5bcf0662f0357e81.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freaper.png)死神

* ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加花費大量時間與敵方坦克進行決鬥，而這些戰鬥通常取決於續航力。由於他移動緩慢且體型巨大，像個海綿一樣會吸收大量傷害，但他同時也能造成高額傷害，因此戰鬥勝負取決於哪一方的坦克獲得更多治療。![](/data/assets/guide/5bcf0662f0357e81.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freaper.png)死神的側襲者（Flanker）風格非常適合騷擾或刺殺敵方輔助英雄，這能極大幫助 ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加贏得坦克對決。此外，當 ![](/data/assets/guide/5bcf0662f0357e81.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freaper.png)死神與 ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加一同在前線作戰時，![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)心臟過載（Cardiac Overdrive）提供的額外生命竊取效果，能讓他們在整整 3 秒內成為一堵無法被擊殺的傷害之牆。
![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)霧子

* 擊殺 ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加最簡單的方法，就是利用像 ![](/data/assets/guide/5845366bf977ed06.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbiotic-grenade.png)生化手榴彈（Biotic Grenade）或 ![](/data/assets/guide/a110bdbe1bbd0f0f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frampage.png)狂暴（Rampage）這類技能對他施加禁止治療的負面效果。![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加主要依賴生命竊取來生存，因此如果他被禁止治療，除非能及時使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)衝鋒（Overrun）逃脫，否則必死無疑。![](/data/assets/guide/617631df12ff0fc7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprotection-suzu.png)保護鈴（Protection Suzu）是清除 ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加身上禁止治療效果的最佳技能，同時還能為他提供瞬間治療。除了淨化效果外，處於狐狸衝刺（Kitsune Rush）狀態下的 ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加簡直是敵人的噩夢。![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)霧子本身也能造成不錯的傷害，從而受益於 ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)心臟過載（Cardiac Overdrive），這點與織命不同，後者是另一位擁有淨化能力的輔助英雄。

8.title: 如何反制
content: 目前為止，![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加（Mauga）最重要的技能是 ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)心臟過載（Cardiac Overdrive）。無論你使用哪位英雄，反制他的核心關鍵都在於抵銷心臟過載所帶來的價值。

你可以透過保留傷害減免技能，在他發動該技能期間進行格擋（例如：![](/data/assets/guide/bd20cd06dd7b0779.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdefense-matrix.png)防禦矩陣（Defense Matrix）、![](/data/assets/guide/1858a99948e6d377.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbarrier-shield.png)屏障護盾（Barrier Shield）、![](/data/assets/guide/50e882867327ed22.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdeflect.png)反射（Deflect）），或者當你看到他身上發光時，使用位移技能逃離他（例如：![](/data/assets/guide/3645240b7a0b07c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffade.png)消散（Fade）、![](/data/assets/guide/71e72edd3dddab12.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjump-pack.png)噴射跳躍（Jump Pack）、![](/data/assets/guide/aa1e1fee6005660a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcoach-gun.png)教練槍（Coach Gun））。

另一件你需要注意的事情是 ![](/data/assets/guide/a5b715f2ad049a53.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverrun.png)衝鋒踐踏（Overrun）。首先，不要被他撞到。請務必保留一個位移技能來閃避，或者待在掩體附近，以便隨時移動離開他的路徑。此外，他的衝鋒冷卻時間非常短，所以務必隨時保持警覺，不要因為沒意識到自己處於他的攻擊範圍內而措手不及。

* 當你想要徹底壓制他時，請安排一位 ![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)安娜（Ana）來對他施加禁療效果，並安排一位 ![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)霧子（Kiriko）來淨化被燃燒的隊友。
